title: FBN Fee Dispute Terms and Fee Credits
content:
A seller may dispute a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) fee no later than the fee dispute window counted in calendar days from that fee's event date. A dispute is upheld when the enrollment records show the fee used the wrong size tier, the wrong program, the wrong season or units that were already on a removal order; the credit is the billed fee less the fee recomputed correctly. A rejected dispute books nothing, and one fee record is credited at most once.

## The time limit

- **Clock starts:** the event date of the fee record disputed, as shown on Northloop's own fee record — the date that fee was billed.
- **Length:** the fee dispute window of the enrollment's program, in calendar days.
- **Comparison:** the dispute is in time when it is raised no later than the last day of the window; the last day itself is inside the window.
- **Evidence:** the fee record of the enrollment, identified by its own reference; the seller's recollection of the billing date does not replace it.

| Day of the dispute (counted from the fee's event date) | In time |
|---|---|
| the day on which the window's number of calendar days is reached | yes |
| the day after that | no |

## Grounds for upholding

| What the enrollment records show about the fee | Outcome |
|---|---|
| wrong size tier used | upheld |
| wrong program used | upheld |
| wrong season used | upheld |
| units already on a removal order were charged | upheld |

## The credit

The credit is the fee as billed less the fee recomputed correctly. Illustration (hypothetical amounts): a storage fee billed at 96.00 USD at a peak rate for a month that is off-peak, which recomputes to 31.20 USD, earns a credit of 64.80 USD.

## Limits

- A rejected dispute books nothing.
- One fee record is credited at most once.
